summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I checked (read-only, no changes made) I traced the full chain: `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `handlers.ts` → `server.ts` mounting → `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `useAuth.tsx` → `App.tsx` routing → `db/auth.ts` (login/session).  Contrary to a plausible first guess, the code as it stands looks **correctly wired**: - `watchlists.user_id` is a required column, every route filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, and there's no default/anonymous fallback ID. - The watchlist router has its own auth middlew
